instruction.text: Look at the tree next to Kayla. Which tool would it be most sensible to use to measure the length of the tree?

correct.text: That’s correct! Tape measures are used to measure very long lengths, like the height of a tree.

wrong.text: Not quite! Look at how big the tree is and have another go.

instruction.text: Look at the potted plant next to Kayla. Which tool would it be most sensible to use to measure the length of the potted plant?

correct.text: That’s correct! Rulers are used to measure objects up to one metre in length, like the height of a potted plant.

wrong.text: Not quite! Look at how big the potted plant is and have another go.
